narrative: The same board. A foul sheet, the top margin cramped in his own hand, above the verse. The bluebottle is still at the glass. No face. Under the note, two lines still wet. The hand is his. Nothing of a second writer.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the opening, and the note above it.

entities.name: Romeo and Juliet
entities.context: Shown on draft in Napkins above the sonnet
